title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
We are supporting a fantastic business based in Lichfield to recruit an Accounts Payable Assistant to join their finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented finance professional looking to gain experience within a fast-paced environment. This is a 4-week temporary contract with the potential to become permanent.

Reporting to the Accounts Payable Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring supplier invoices are processed accurately and payments are made on time. You will work closely with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers, helping to maintain strong relationships while supporting the smooth running of the finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices, ensuring accurate coding and timely posting.
- Matching purchase orders, invoices and delivery notes.
- Preparing supplier payment runs and processing employee expenses.
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any discrepancies.
- Handling supplier and internal queries via phone and email.
- Assisting with month-end finance activities and reporting requirements.
- Supporting continuous improvements across accounts payable processes and procedures.

About You
- Previous experience within an Accounts Payable, Purchase Ledger or Finance Assistant role would be advantageous.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable using finance or ERP systems.
- Able to manage workloads effectively and meet deadlines.
- Confident communicator with a proactive and professional approach.
- A finance-related qualification or degree would be beneficial but is not essential.

If you are immediately available and seeking you next role in Accounts Payable, please apply directly below!

title: Credit Control
description:
A successful and expanding organisation is looking to recruit an experienced and motivated Credit Controller to join its growing finance team. This is a varied and fast-paced role and excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a diverse workload, building customer relationships and being part of a busy finance function. With continued growth and exciting future plans, the company offers a supportive and collaborative working environment where employees are encouraged to develop, take ownership and contribute to the success of the business.

Working as part of a friendly finance team, you will be responsible for managing the credit control process while supporting the wider sales ledger and billing functions. You will proactively chase outstanding payments, maintain customer accounts, allocate cash, reconcile ledgers and resolve customer account queries in a professional and timely manner. You will also prepare and issue invoices, investigate discrepancies, process account adjustments where required and work closely with colleagues across the business to ensure customer accounts remain accurate.

Ideally you will have:
- Previous experience in Credit Control, Sales Ledger, Accounts Receivable or a similar finance role.
- Experience managing customer accounts, chasing outstanding debt, raising invoices and allocating cash.
- Strong customer service and communication skills with the confidence to build relationships and resolve account queries professionally.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy and varied workload.

In return, you will receive:
- The opportunity to join a well-established and growing business with exciting future plans.
- Flexible working hours and hybrid working to improve work-life balance.
- A friendly and supportive team environment where collaboration is encouraged.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.

If you are an ambitious finance professional looking for a varied Credit Control role where you can utilise your experience while developing your sales ledger, billing and customer service skills, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now!

title: Credit Controller FTC 6 months
description:
Credit Controller

Stafford £30,000 6 Month Fixed-Term Contract

Are you an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys building relationships, resolving queries and driving cash collection? We are recruiting for a hands-on Credit Controller to join a busy finance team on a 6-month fixed-term contract.

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively chase outstanding debt via telephone and email
- Manage and prioritise aged debt across multiple customer accounts
- Build strong working relationships with customers and internal teams
- Investigate and resolve invoice queries, disputes and payment issues
- Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies
- Allocate cash receipts and obtain remittance advice
- Maintain accurate collection notes and payment commitments
- Escalate overdue balances and unresolved issues when required
- Support the management of complex and historic debt balances

About You
- Previous experience within Credit Control or Accounts Receivable
- Proven track record of reducing aged debt and improving cash collection
- Confident communicating with customers over the phone
- Strong reconciliation and account investigation skills
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- Proactive, persistent and able to manage your own workload
- Good Excel skills

Package
- Salary: £30,000 per annum (pro rata)
- 6 Month Fixed-Term Contract
- Monday to Thursday: 7:30am - 4:30pm
- Friday: 7:30am - 3:30pm
- 20 days holiday plus bank holidays (pro rata)
- Company pension scheme
- Fully office-based role
- Potential opportunity for the role to become permanent for the right person, subject to business requirements

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller looking for a varied position where they can make an immediate impact within a supportive finance team.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator (Part-time, 30 hours)

Are you tired of following old-fashioned, antiquated and outdated processes?

Are you looking for a business that will welcome a forward thinking and modern approach?

If you have answered YES, then you need to READ ON

This world leading manufacturing business based in Stoke on Trent offers its iconic products and design options and currently ship their products to over 100 countries across the globe.

I am supporting this business with the recruitment of a Payroll Administrator on a part-time basis to join a thriving, successful and growing business and supporting the Payroll Manager to take the payroll process to the next level.

You will be a key part of the HR & Payroll Team, ensuring all employees are paid accurately, carrying out daily payroll tasks and working as a small team of 3 in Payroll with all deadlines and year-end tasks.

Investing heavily in its people this business offers an incredible benefits package including; 25 days holiday + bank holidays, increased pension contributions, life insurance and support with healthcare.

What we need from you?
- Ensuring all employees are paid accurately and adhering to the pay deadlines across the 5 payrolls.
- Processing weekly and monthly payrolls that are extensive with varying pay rules, circa 800 employees.
- Carry out daily payroll tasks such as checking all clocking's monthly, holiday calculation, applying deductions and processing statutory payments.
- Ensuring all reporting is done in a timely manner.
- Supporting the Payroll Manager with all deadlines and Year End tasks.
- Ensure that all employee queries are dealt with in a timely and accurate manner.
- Put accurate information onto the system and support the Payroll manager in any additional information that may be required.
- Maintain accurate records for Starters and Leavers on the Payroll and T&A systems.
- Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of relevant legislation.
- Administer pension arrangements through the specific provider.
- Minimum 2 years working within a similar role - which should include multiple payrolls, with varying rules.

Essential Details

Position - Payroll Administrator

Permanent - Part Time 30 hours per week (4 days or spread over 5 days)

Location - Stoke on Trent

Salary - £22,400 pro rata salary (FTE £28k) + incredible benefits package

Permanent
Monday - Thursday 8am - 4.15pm Friday 8am - 3pm
Stoke on Trent £28,000

Working alongside the Payroll Manager, you'll provide day-to-day administrative support across the payroll function.
From processing payroll information and maintaining employee records to dealing with queries, supporting pension administration and assisting with statutory payments, you'll play an important part in keeping everything running smoothly and meeting key payroll deadlines.

- Around 1-2 years' recent experience working within a payroll environment
- A good understanding of payroll processes and relevant legislation
- Experience using computerised payroll systems

- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work

You'll be joining a professional People & Culture team where you'll have the support and training you need to settle into the role and develop your knowledge.

title: Payroll and Benefits Officer
description:
Payroll and Benefits Officer (Part time - 24 hours per week)
Staffordshire £30-32 K (Pro Rata) Permanent
We're looking for an experienced payroll professional to take ownership of a varied, standalone payroll position based in Staffordshire.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys getting stuck into the detail. The payroll currently involves a mixture of manual processes, so you'll need to be comfortable working this way whilst also supporting the business as it continues to move towards more digital ways of working.

The role will include:
- Managing payroll for up to 250 employees
- Processing a mixture of lunar and monthly payrolls
- Managing different pay types including hourly, minimum wage and salaried employees
- Supporting a separate pensioner payroll linked to a final salary scheme
- Processing payroll using Sage 50 Payroll
- Managing pensions, including auto-enrolment and annual pension audits
- Working with pension providers including Aviva and The People's Pension
- Managing timesheets and ensuring payroll is processed accurately and on time
- Helping to improve and digitalise existing payroll processes

What we're looking for!
- You'll be an experienced payroll professional who is confident managing a busy and occasionally complex payroll.
- Previous experience using Sage 50 Payroll is important, and exposure to Sage HR would be beneficial.
- You'll also be comfortable working with manual processes, rather than expecting everything to be fully automated from day one.
- Experience of payrolls involving different rates, pay structures or employee groups would be particularly useful.

The role is part time, and we are looking for the successful candidate to work Mondays and Thursdays in office, with some flexibility around the working pattern.

If you're looking for a part-time payroll role where you can genuinely take ownership and help shape how the function works moving forward, this could be a really good fit.

Application Disclaimer: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion.
Thank you for taking the time to apply.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk

If you are an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk or Finance Administrator with a proven background in working within a fast paced, motivated team and business, then read on

Consult KA have partnered with a successful services based business who have an incredible UK customer base. This is a hands-on, short-term opportunity suited to someone with relevant purchase ledger experience who is organised, detail-focused and comfortable working to daily deadlines.

A detailed orientated person who can support the business in ensuring that invoices and payments are properly approved, someone who has the ability to liaise confidently with various department and keep track of what is owed to vendors.

Position - Purchase Ledger Clerk
